verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a dedicated security page covering some mail-handling and account protections: on-site mobile shredding with destruction certificates, an option to keep mail unopened and unscanned, 2FA via authenticator app, and willingness to sign a HIPAA BAA. However, it does not describe the specific controls the story asks about. Missing for 10: facility physical-access controls, staff background screening, encryption of scans at rest or in transit, any third-party audit or attestation, and independent corroboration.
